task: Check whether checked-body-v1 can add collection expression tags without changing existing wire bytes or invoking legacy fallback in the prior consumer.
observation: A compatibility probe compiled the D1 checked-body reader and confirmed it rejects both new CollectionCount and Index tags. Inspection of the D1 import projection confirmed decode errors are converted to a compiler rejection, so a new body does not continue through generic_stmt reconstruction. Golden semantic hashes captured with the D1 encoder also remained stable after appending tags 15 and 16.
impact: The exact tag guard, fail-closed importer path, and byte-derived hash snapshots provided concrete evidence for an additive v1 extension without a record-schema migration.

resolution.summary: The D2 codec extends existing v1 node tags additively; baseline H3 consumer rejection and current H3 fixture hashes are covered by regression tests.
